name: WgCanvas
brief: A class for the rendering graphic elements with a WebGPU raster engine.

members.name: target
members.signature: Result target(void* device, void* instance, void* target, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, ColorSpace cs, int type = 0) noexcept
members.brief: Sets the drawing target for the rasterization.

params.name: device
params.description: WGPUDevice, a desired handle for the wgpu device.

params.name: instance
params.description: WGPUInstance, context for all other wgpu objects.

params.name: target
params.description: Either WGPUSurface or WGPUTexture, serving as handles to a presentable surface or texture.

params.name: cs
params.description: Specifies how the pixel values should be interpreted. Currently, it allows `ColorSpace::ABGR8888` and `ColorSpace::ABGR8888S`.

params.name: type
params.description: @c 0: surface, @c 1: texture are used as pesentable target.

retvals.description: if the canvas is performing rendering. Please ensure the canvas is synced.
In case the wg engine is not supported.

warnings: Regardless of the value of `cs`, this target API uses the default alpha mode.

members.name: gen
members.signature: static WgCanvas* gen(EngineOption op = EngineOption::Default) noexcept
members.brief: Creates a new WebGPU Canvas object with optional rendering engine settings.
description: This method generates a WebGPU canvas instance that can be used for drawing vector graphics. It accepts an optional parameter `op` to choose between different rendering engine behaviors.

params.name: op
params.description: The rendering engine option. Default is `EngineOption::Default`.

notes: Currently, it does not support `EngineOption::SmartRender`. The request will be ignored.

nested.name: Context
nested.brief: Encapsulates the WebGPU context required for rendering.
description: This structure contains the WebGPU objects used to initialize the rendering backend.
